answer_1.quote: ...the LLM generates a small set of candidate generic names that abstract the core concept of each menu item, stripping away brand-specific or overly detailed language. The result is a semantically enriched dataset in which each menu item is described by a standardized category and a concise generalized name...
answer_1.outputs: generic menu item names and category labels

answer_2.quote: We assess clustering quality and refinement effectiveness using four metrics: intra-cluster similarity, inter-cluster similarity, number of clusters, and cluster coverage.

answer_4.quote: more than 30% of all LLM-generated categories are manually checked for correctness and semantic appropriateness. In addition, approximately 80% of all clusters are manually reviewed to ensure that the items grouped together represent the same or closely related menu offerings.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators examine generated categories and clusters for correctness and semantic appropriateness.
